facts.text: Judson College serves as the undergraduate school of Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary, offering degree programs rooted in a conservative theological curriculum and the Great Books.

sources.title: About - Judson College
sources.quote: Judson College began in 1994 as an undergraduate school of Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary, which opened its doors in 1950 with a mandate to train students to serve churches along the east coast of the United States.

sources.title: About - Judson College
sources.quote: As a fully accredited, four-year Christian college, Judson College combines the best of a conservative biblical and theological education with professional training in a vibrant Christian community.
